```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ape)
library(phytools)
library(tibble)

```

# load data 
```{r}
# -------------------------
# 1. Helper functions
# -------------------------
clean_species_names <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    gsub('"', '', .) %>%
    gsub("'", "", .) %>%
    gsub(" ", "_", .) %>%
    str_to_lower()
}

reconcile_species_names <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_species_names(x)

  recode_map <- c(
    "amanita_muscariaflavivolvata" = "amanita_muscaria_flavivolvata",
    "limacella_illinita" = "zhuliangomyces_illinitus",
    "amanita_phalloides" = "amanita_phalloides_sensu_auct._amer."
  )

  dplyr::recode(x, !!!recode_map, .default = x)
}

read_clean_tree <- function(file_path, outgroup = NULL) {
  tr <- tryCatch(
    read.nexus(file_path),
    error = function(e) read.tree(file_path)
  )

  if (inherits(tr, "multiPhylo")) {
    tr <- tr[[1]]
  }

  tr$tip.label <- clean_species_names(tr$tip.label)
  tr$tip.label <- reconcile_species_names(tr$tip.label)

  if (!is.null(outgroup) && outgroup %in% tr$tip.label) {
    tr <- root(tr, outgroup = outgroup, resolve.root = TRUE)
  }

  if (!is.null(tr$edge.length)) {
    tr$edge.length[tr$edge.length <= 0] <- 1e-8
  }

  tr$node.label <- NULL
  tr
}

estimate_trait_signal <- function(tree, df, trait_col) {
  d <- df %>%
    select(species, all_of(trait_col)) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    filter(species %in% tree$tip.label)

  tree_trait <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, d$species))

  if (!is.null(tree_trait$edge.length)) {
    tree_trait$edge.length[tree_trait$edge.length <= 0] <- 1e-8
  }

  d <- d %>%
    slice(match(tree_trait$tip.label, species))

  x <- d[[trait_col]]
  names(x) <- d$species

  lambda_fit <- phytools::phylosig(tree_trait, x, method = "lambda", test = TRUE)
  k_fit      <- phytools::phylosig(tree_trait, x, method = "K", test = TRUE)

  tibble(
    trait = trait_col,
    N = length(x),
    pagel_lambda = lambda_fit$lambda,
    pagel_lambda_logL = lambda_fit$logL,
    pagel_lambda_P = lambda_fit$P,
    blomberg_K = k_fit$K,
    blomberg_K_P = k_fit$P
  )
}
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# 2. Input files
# -------------------------
outgroup_name <- "zhuliangomyces_illinitus"

pca_file  <- "Results/PCA/PCA_Spore_Scores_Aggregated_with_Count.csv"
vol_file  <- "Results/Volume/Volume.csv"
tree_file <- "Results/Phylogeny/species_tree_output.tree"

```

```{r}

# -------------------------
# 3. Load data
# -------------------------
pca <- read_csv(pca_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(species = reconcile_species_names(species))

vol <- read_csv(vol_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(species = reconcile_species_names(species))

df <- pca %>%
  select(species, PC1_mean) %>%
  left_join(
    vol %>% select(species, avg_volume_estimated),
    by = "species"
  )

# -------------------------
# 4. Read tree
# -------------------------
tree <- read_clean_tree(tree_file, outgroup = outgroup_name)

```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# 5. Estimate phylogenetic signal
# -------------------------
trait_signal_results <- bind_rows(
  estimate_trait_signal(tree, df, "PC1_mean"),
  estimate_trait_signal(tree, df, "avg_volume_estimated")
)

trait_signal_results

```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# 6. Save results
# -------------------------
dir.create("Results/stats/phylogenetic_signal", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_csv(
  trait_signal_results,
  "Results/stats/phylogenetic_signal/phylogenetic_signal_PC1_volume.csv"
)
```
